column1: # The API table of glide2x.dll: every export of 3dfx's Glide 2.43 for Voodoo Graphics, from the Win95 glide2x.dll of the Glide 2.43
# Written by tools/pe/apitable.py from the original's own code; the stub column was added by
# hand. wrappers/stubgen.py writes glide2x.def and src/stubs.rs from this file: each export this
# library does not implement yet becomes a stub that logs its call and returns `stub`.
# Columns: export name, Rust name, stdcall or cdecl, argument bytes (stdcall), parameter
# count (- unknown), return kind (int, void, float, - unknown), the stub's return value.
# Also the 12 calls of Glide 2.1.1 (glide.dll, the library early Glide 2 games import; on POD's
# first-edition patch, glide.exe) that 2.43 does not have. Glide 2.1.1's grSplash takes no
# arguments (_grSplash@0), so its Rust name is grSplash21.
# Glide has no header here: returns are - except guFogTableIndexToW, a float (the Glide 2.x
# reference manual). A stub returns 0, which is FXFALSE for the calls that return FxBool.
